name: Granitebrook Builders
description: Housebuilder developing estates in the fictional county of Thorncastle.

items.title: Published scaffold collapse investigation
items.content: The safety regulator's public notice GBB-HSE-0310 says a scaffold collapsed at the Oakfield Rise site on 2026-03-10, injuring 2 workers, because 17 ties had been removed early. Granitebrook was fined $162,000.

items.title: Show home opening times
items.content: Show homes at Linden Vale open Thursday to Monday, 10:25 to 16:35. House types start at $289,950. Leaflet GBB-SH-4.

items.title: Site induction rules
items.content: Every worker completes a 46-minute induction and gets a green helmet sticker; the site manager, Declan Rourke, keeps the sign-in book GBB-IND-46.

items.title: Snagging process
items.content: Buyers report snags within 2 years; minor snags are fixed within 14 working days, logged in GBB-SNG-207.

items.title: Land purchase at Harrow Fields
items.request_phrase: the land purchase at Harrow Fields
items.content: Granitebrook agreed to buy 31.4 acres at Harrow Fields for $8.6M, subject to planning for 260 homes; exchange is on 2027-02-05. Deal GBB-LND-0205-H.

items.title: Cladding defect liability
items.content: Tests found that cladding on 48 homes on our newest estate does not meet fire rules; replacement will cost about $2.9M and buyers have not been told. Report GBB-CLD-4829-L.
